files.schema.md:
# News site schema (DatoCMS)

- article: title, slug, body (HTML), author_name (string), author_photo (file), tags (string, comma separated), homepage_hero (boolean)
- author: name, bio
- homepage: hero_article_1 (link), hero_article_2 (link), hero_article_3 (link)
